title: Mercury, lead and methanol discovered in seized counterfeit cosmetics in the UK
summary: An investigation by the Intellectual Property Office (IPO) found that four in ten seized counterfeit cosmetics tested failed safety checks, and the IPO is highlighting these risks via a new ‘Face the Fakes’ campaign

extraction.key_fact: 영국에서 압수된 위조 화장품 상당수가 안전 검사를 통과하지 못했다.
